解析：曲线与路径无关，故

$$z=\int_0^x e^{x+y}(x-y+2)+e^xy\,dx+\int_0^y(1-ye^y)\,dy+C_0$$

$$=[(x-y+1)e^{x+y}+ye^x]\Big|_0^x+(y-ye^y+e^y)\Big|_0^y+C_0$$

$$=(x-y+1)e^{x+y}+ye^x+C$$

已知 $dz=e^{x+y}[e^y(x-y+2)+y]dx+e^x[e^y(x-y)+1]dy$，则 $z=$（ ） $(2x-y+1)e^{x+y}+C$ $(x-y+1)e^{x+y}+ye^x+C$ $(x-y+2)e^x+ye^{x+y}+C$ $(x-y)e^{x+y}+ye^x+C$ 解析：曲线与路径无关，故

$$z=\int_0^x e^{x+y}(x-y+2)+e^xy\,dx+\int_0^y(1-ye^y)\,dy+C_0$$

$$=[(x-y+1)e^{x+y}+ye^x]\Big|_0^x+(y-ye^y+e^y)\Big|_0^y+C_0$$

$$=(x-y+1)e^{x+y}+ye^x+C$$
